import statistics
import sys
import time

from crayon import options as crayon_options

crayon_options(**{"crayon.enabled": True})
from diffobj.styles import AlignThreshold

def one():
    a = AlignThreshold()
    flag = "TRUE" if a.count_alnum_only else "FALSE"
    return f"{a.threshold}|{a.min_chars}|{flag}"

value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
text = value if isinstance(value, str) else "\n".join(value)
sys.stdout.write("VALUE\n")
sys.stdout.write(text)
sys.stdout.write("\n<<<END>>>\n")
sys.stdout.write(f"MS {statistics.median(elapsed):.17g}\n")

import os
import statistics
import time
from pathlib import Path

from diffobj import *
from diffobj.options import settings
a = list("abcdef")
b = ["b", "CC", "DD", "d", "f"]

def enc(rows):
    parts = []
    for row in rows:
        val = "NA" if row["val"] is None else row["val"]
        ida = "NA" if row["id_a"] is None else str(row["id_a"])
        idb = "NA" if row["id_b"] is None else str(row["id_b"])
        parts.append("|".join([row["op"], val, ida, idb]))
    return ";".join(parts)

def one():
    return ses_dat(a, b)

value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
print(enc(value))
print(f"MS {statistics.median(elapsed):.17g}")
